messages.content: What's the quickest way to check if a Python string contains only digits?

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants a concise way to validate that a string contains only digits in Python.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Use str.isdigit(). Example: "123".isdigit() returns True; "12.3".isdigit() returns False.</content>
</action>
